title: Microwave-assisted reductive homocoupling of aromatic nitro monomers: synthesis of azo-linked porous organic polymers for CO2 capture
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,7332-7339
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA00410A, Paper

Željka Car, Mladen Borovina, Barbara Panić, Ivana Biljan
A rapid and efficient microwave-assisted synthesis of azo-linked porous organic polymers for CO2 capture via NaBH4-mediated reductive homocoupling of aromatic nitro monomers is presented.
